Developer Tools-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Developer Tools marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general Gatekeeper or MDM guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Developer Tools permission claims:

开发者工具 vs 开发者工具权限 vs 本地运行软件

US pages say "Developer Tools", "Run software locally", or "Enable in System Settings → Developer Tools." China storefront copy often uses 开发者工具 for general Developer Tools positioning aligned with Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Tools, 开发者工具权限 when the hero frame shows the permission rationale or access scope, and 本地运行软件 when English source emphasizes local binary execution or run-software-locally workflows. AppLocale picks commerce-idiomatic phrasing per frame — not 门禁 on consumer Developer Tools screenshots, not 隐私偏好策略控制 on grant panels, and not 托管应用 on TCC permission walkthroughs.

Developer Tools vs Gatekeeper

Consumer Developer Tools (开发者工具) lets end users toggle per-app grants to run software locally and communicate with developer-tool providers in System Settings after consent. Gatekeeper (门禁) governs system-wide macOS software trust — App Store only vs identified developers vs anywhere, spctl notarization enforcement. English shares "developer" vocabulary — Chinese storefront copy must not conflate per-app 开发者工具 TCC grants with fleet 门禁 Gatekeeper policy. Gatekeeper frames belong on the Gatekeeper listing guide when software trust leads — not mixed into Developer Tools captions unless each frame is labeled honestly.

Developer Tools vs PPPC

Consumer Developer Tools (开发者工具) lets end users toggle per-app grants in System Settings after consent. PPPC (隐私偏好策略控制) lets IT admins deploy PrivacyPreferencesPolicyControl payloads that pre-grant or deny Developer Tools for named apps on enrolled Macs. PPPC frames and developer-tools-mdm grant intents belong on the PPPC listing guide when MDM TCC grants lead — not mixed into consumer Developer Tools grant captions unless each frame is labeled honestly.

Developer Tools vs Full Disk Access and Files and Folders

Developer Tools permission governs local software execution and developer-tool provider communication — 开发者工具. Full Disk Access governs broad file-system access beyond the sandbox — 完全磁盘访问. Files and Folders governs scoped per-folder grants — 文件与文件夹. A run-software-locally toggle is not an FDA grant list and not a Documents folder toggle. Full Disk Access frames belong on the Full Disk Access listing guide; Files and Folders frames belong on the Files and Folders listing guide when those features lead.

Developer Tools vs Managed Apps and App Management

Developer Tools TCC (开发者工具) governs whether apps may run local software and communicate with developer-tool providers after grants in System Settings. Managed Apps (托管应用) governs MDM push, install, remove, and update of apps on enrolled devices. App Management is a separate consumer TCC panel for controlling which apps may update or delete other apps. A System Settings Developer Tools toggle is not an MDM silent-install dashboard and not an App Management permission frame. Managed Apps frames belong on the Managed Apps listing guide when fleet app lifecycle leads.
